intentAlignment.basis: WI-229 is the bounded successor required because hosted CI found an out-of-scope parity registration gap only after WI-228 had immutable archive and finalization bytes. It preserves that predecessor truth, carries the corrective validator delivery, and adds only the exact tri-language parity registrations needed for an auditable hosted handoff.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The cherry-picked WI-228 implementation and immutable predecessor lifecycle bytes remain byte-identical while the bounded validator accepts only the fixed same-Work-Item receipt pair and all negative paths remain fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare predecessor artifact digests, then run the protocol and repository resource-finalization regressions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese reference-parity each contain one WI-228 row and one WI-229 row with the exact verification and recovery/finalization paths and the language-specific implemented state token.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation acceptance, parity integrity, and parity regression gates after adding only the six bounded rows.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Installed Runtime v0.2.28 binds the current Contract and PR-stage workspace evidence, archives a visible Chinese Outcome, records only a canonical pre-merge finalization receipt, and hosted quality, Windows, and V1 checks pass before merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Complete preflight/checkpoint/verify/finish/archive/finalize, push the reviewed branch, and inspect every hosted check without closing before merge.
